purpose: Assistant-led property-management and portfolio-operator buyer expansion. Discovery directories may identify managers, but records in this artifact are verified against direct company/current professional sources before inclusion.
safety: Inventory seed only. Does not send outreach. Service opportunities are hypotheses, not claims that a manager is dissatisfied with existing vendors. Zillow/Apartments.com/RentalSource-type sources are discovery signals only and must not auto-promote a buyer without direct or authoritative verification.

records.category_label: property management companies and portfolio operators
commercial_service_hypotheses: HVAC, plumbing and electrical vendor sourcing
junk hauling and move-out debris removal
parking-lot sweeping / striping for applicable multifamily or commercial properties
records.bmc_offer_hypothesis: BMC can act as an on-demand local vendor-sourcing and coordination layer for maintenance, turns, emergency repairs and recurring exterior/facility work, reducing the manager's need to repeatedly find and vet local contractors.
records.note: Direct company site lists Prescott, Prescott Valley, Chino Valley, Dewey and Humboldt service areas and explicitly says it works with independent third-party service providers. This is a strong BMC vendor-coordination buyer hypothesis; current need still requires qualification.
